citations.title: Privacy Policy
excerpts: Personal data that we collect from you may be transferred to and stored at a destination outside your place of residence, including outside the EEA/UK. Due to the global nature of our business, your personal data will be disclosed to our portfolio companies, based on an intragroup data processing agreement, in Hong Kong, the USA and Singapore. We may also share personal data to other portfolio companies as part of international engagements, and where required or desirable to meet our legal and regulatory obligations around the world.

All our personal data transfers are compliant with applicable data protection laws. The agreements we have in place with our portfolio companies and with our third-party service providers include appropriate safeguards to ensure that data flows are safe and that individuals can exercise their data protection rights. These include [standard contractual clauses approved by the EU Commission](https://commission.europa.eu/law/law-topic/data-protection/international-dimension-data-protection/standard-contractual-clauses-scc_en) , or other arrangements, as applicable in specific countries, and other safeguards as may be appropriate. We may also transfer data to countries with an adequate level of personal data protection based on decisions adopted by competent authorities, such as the adequacy decisions adopted by the European Commission or approved in accordance with the UK GDPR.

basis.reasoning: Multiplier Holdings’ privacy policy says its personal-data transfers comply with applicable data-protection laws and specifically refers to the UK GDPR. Of the listed items, GDPR is the only one named in this claim; the policy does not identify SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS certifications. GDPR is not technically a certification, so this classification is somewhat interpretive.
